metadata.title: Time-to-convergence, VI vs SMC on the hockey-stick DGP

convergence_criterion.definition: At each snapshot (every LOG_EVERY epochs), compute the L2 distance between the mean 12-D free-theta vector over the last CONV_WINDOW snapshots and the mean over the CONV_WINDOW snapshots before those. Convergence declared at the first snapshot where this drift stays below CONV_TAU for CONV_HOLD consecutive checks.
